mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market weakness that signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (over 3-year rolling window), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth and monthly housing starts indicate weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both GDPC1 6m change < 0 and HOUST 6m change < 0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, industrial production growth above 105 signals sustained economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion with INDPRO > 105 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPIAUCSL change exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment trend (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 5-day forward returns in PAYEMS growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals an economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate growing consumer demand that fuels economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 20-day returns in early-cycle expansion with HOUST growth are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
